lines.text: وضیافتها و از اعضا منسوبست بپشت و دل و شکم که زایل را لعبت دلیل باشد بر حالت ثبات
lines.en: and banquets, and of the body parts it is attributed to the back, heart, and stomach, which for the transient is an indicator of the state of stability

lines.text: او از عبید و خادم و ستور که از جمله اسباب مکسب و بیماری که بسبب خول حیات بخانه
lines.en: of it, from slaves, servants, and beasts of burden, which are among the means of earning, and illness that due to the entry of life into the house

lines.text: سقوط از طالع از این علت گفت که بیت سادس خانه خدمتکاران و بندگان و مرضها
lines.en: Falling from the ascendant is for this reason, he said, that the sixth house is the house of servants, slaves, and illnesses

lines.text: و آفتها و دواب صغار است و ایضا دالت بر گریخته و گم شده و تهمت و از اعضا منسوبست
lines.en: and afflictions and small beasts of burden, and also it indicates the stolen and lost and accusation, and of the body parts it is attributed

lines.text: بناف و شکم و هفتم که وتد غارب است بر آئینه ضد طالع بود و نظیر او پس دال باشد بر ازواج
lines.en: to the navel and stomach. And the seventh, which is the setting angle, is the mirror opposite of the ascendant and its counterpart, so it indicates spouses

lines.text: و شرکا و سبب هلاکی و فاجون اضداد و خصوم از اینوجه گفت که بیت سابع خانه شرکاء
lines.en: and partners and the cause of destruction and sudden opponents and adversaries. From this aspect he said that the seventh house is the house of partners

lines.text: و ازواج و عوراتست و ایضا دالت بر اضداد و خصوم و مقصد مسافران و گرانی و
lines.en: and spouses and women, and also it indicates opponents and adversaries and the destination of travelers and dearness and

lines.text: ارزانی و از اعضا منسوبست بسیرین و زیر ناف و هشتم که مایل و سابعست حالت دویم
lines.en: cheapness, and of the body parts it is attributed to the buttocks and below the navel. And the eighth, which is succedent to the seventh, is the second state

lines.text: ازواج بود چون مقابل و ضد ثانیست دلیل بطلان اسباب بقا و معیشت بود از
lines.en: of spouses. Since it is opposite and contrary to the second, it is an indicator of the nullification of the means of survival and livelihood. From

lines.text: این ممر گفت که بیت ثامن خانه خوف و مرگ و میراثها و اموال اموات و غم و اندوه
lines.en: this passage, it is said that the eighth house is the house of fear, death, inheritances, the wealth of the dead, and sorrow and grief.

lines.text: است و ایضا دالت بر اموال و خصوم و اضداد و فقر و فاقه و از اعضا منسوبست
lines.en: and also it indicates wealth and adversaries and opponents and poverty and destitution, and of the body parts it is attributed

lines.text: بالات شهوت و مقعد و رحم و نهم که ثانی الموتست دلالت کند بر حالت ثانی از
lines.en: to the organs of lust and the anus and the womb. And the ninth, which is the second from death, indicates the second state of

lines.text: حیثیت زمان مثل امور اخروي و از حیثیت فرعیت مثل خواب چه نکته النوم اخ الموت
lines.en: the aspect of time, like otherworldly affairs, and from the aspect of derivation, like sleep, for the point is 'sleep is the brother of death'

lines.text: مشهور و معروفست و نیز چون نظیر ثالثست و اقوي از او دال بود بر علم بسیار و سفر
lines.en: is famous and well-known. And also since it is the counterpart of the third and stronger than it, it indicates much knowledge and travel

lines.text: دور از ایندلایل گفت که بیت تاسع خانه سفر دور و دین و علم و زهد و فکر و عقل
lines.en: far. From these indicators he said that the ninth house is the house of far travel and religion and knowledge and asceticism and thought and intellect

lines.text: و خوابست و ایضا دالت بر وفاداري و تدبیر و کیفیت احوال عافیان و از اعضا
lines.en: and sleep, and also it indicates loyalty and management and the quality of the states of the healthy, and of the body parts

lines.text: منسوبست به فخذین و دهم چون ارفع و اعلی و اقوی بیوتست و نظیر بیت الاب از
lines.en: it is attributed to the thighs. And the tenth, since it is the highest and most elevated and strongest of the houses and the counterpart of the house of the father, from

lines.text: این سبب گفت بیت عاشر خانه سلطان و مادران و اشغال اعمال سلطانیست
lines.en: this cause he said the tenth house is the house of the sultan and mothers and the occupations of royal deeds

lines.text: و ایضا دالت بر صفت و رفعت و مشهور و معروف گشتی و از اعضا منسوبست برکبتین
lines.en: and also it indicates attribute and elevation and becoming famous and well-known, and of the body parts it is attributed to the knees

summary.headline: Meanings of the Sixth–Tenth Houses
summary.text: Interpretation of the sixth through tenth astrological houses: servants, illness, theft, spouses, partners, opponents, death, inheritance, far travel, religion, knowledge, sleep, rulers, mothers, royal occupations, fame, and bodily correspondences.
